Priya Singh: Noticed per-route cost cards go flat-zero during the rollout when router flips to prefetch variant. This is alarming for product teams.
Marcus Lee: Which card exactly? The marginal-cost column or the per-invocation breakdown?
Priya Singh: marginal-cost. The ingest flags prefetch_replay and we drop unit_cost so SUM becomes 0.
Ivy Chen: We originally excluded replays to avoid double-counting cache hits, but hiding cost is a bad UX.
Priya Singh: Proposal: emit effective_unit_cost + route_variant + credit_reason in econ_event v2 and expose sampling_rate + sample_count in the hover. Keep net as default but offer "Show gross" toggle.
Marcus Lee: Implementation plan: proto bump -> ingest rollout -> consumers -> dashboard query switch with feature flag. I'll own proto + ingest.
Ivy Chen: Add credit_reason enum (prefetch_hit, prefetch_replay, router_fallback). Also attach sampling_rate at emit time.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary scheduled for cost-ingest-v2 on cluster-2 at 2024-07-10T22:00Z
Priya Singh: Dashboard SQL sketch: SELECT route, route_variant, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, SUM(tokens * COALESCE(effective_unit_cost, unit_cost)) AS net_cost, SUM(tokens * unit_cost) AS gross_cost, AVG(sampling_rate) AS sampling_rate, SUM(sample_count) AS sample_count FROM econ_events WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end GROUP BY route, route_variant;
Marcus Lee: Consumers should compute cost using COALESCE to preserve compatibility. Add migration notes.
Ivy Chen: UX: low-sample <100 -> show "Estimate noisy" banner and gray-out the sparkline. Default net but dotted gross overlay.
Priya Singh: Action items: Marcus PR for proto + migration, Ivy produce mockups and copy, Priya update dashboard queries and add feature flag.
Marcus Lee: Will open PR today and link it here.
Priya Singh: Thanks. Let's avoid invisible costs during rollouts.
